verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents a dedicated month-end close feature (AI Close) that uses AI agents to reconcile accounts and review transactions, plus a bank and credit-card reconciliation workflow, so the core close process exists. Nothing in the evidence shows a checklist structure, task tracking, accrual close steps, or reviewer sign-offs. missing for 10: a documented close checklist with per-task status tracking, accrual tasks within the close, review/sign-off approvals, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs

citations.quote: AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
performing a reconciliation is the best way to ensure every single transaction is accounted for and matches your bank statement exactly
